card.name: Linking words in comparisons and contrasts
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, to, than, of, on and based, where a second item in a pair or comparison is expected next. Also the word days after a number and partway through the word discontinuation.

modes.label: Comparison links
modes.description: A preposition or conjunction that sets up the second item of a comparison or pair.
modes.example: and in women compared<< to>> men.

modes.label: Time and discontinuation terms
modes.description: The word days after a number, or the middle of discontinuation, in drug-interaction warnings.
modes.example: or within 14<< days>> after their discontinuation.

modes.label: Paired actions
modes.description: A word that sits before a matching opposite, as in on and off.
modes.example: turn pumps<< on>> and off, open and close valves,
